description: Transaction receipt on Gnosis (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in xDAI, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use gnosis_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x2b56c1dabbef9c9a07d0f94c6ff931c3e1f93cc398fa06296ff79770d4a4487f. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: gnosis_receipt
title: Gnosis transaction receipt
